# NORDA PE Workshop I, Test Case 3b, 250 Hz: transmission loss from a normal-mode solution.
# 
# Problem: Davis, J. A., White, D. and Cavanagh, R. C., "NORDA Parabolic Equation Workshop",
# NORDA Technical Note 143 (1982), Test Case 3b; Jensen, Kuperman, Porter & Schmidt,
# Computational Ocean Acoustics, 2nd ed., Sect. 6.4.2.4 uses a variant of it.
# Range-independent: isovelocity water 1500 m/s, density 1.0, 100 m deep, over a
# homogeneous fluid bottom 1590 m/s, density 1.2, 0.5 dB/wavelength; source and receiver
# both 99.5 m deep, 0.5 m above the seafloor. The COUPLE documentation describes the case
# as demonstrating the importance of high-angle modes.
# 
# Solution: COUPLE07 (R. B. Evans, December 2007 version, distributed by OALIB as
# Modes/couple/couple07.zip), its own Test Case 1 input run unchanged: 28 modes,
# cylindrical geometry, two identical regions. COUPLE closes the bottom with a
# pressure-release boundary at 400 m; the 300 m of sediment above it carry 0.5 dB/wavelength
# throughout, about 47 wavelengths at 250 Hz, so the false bottom returns nothing measurable.
# Built with gfortran -std=legacy and stubs for the Lahey TIMER/DATE intrinsics; runtime < 1 s.
# Only this generated table is shipped: the COUPLE source carries no licence.
# 
# TL is dB re 1 m.
#
